title: HTML escape
skill: Give the full escape table and the raw-HTML rule

good: Fix the template engine in src/template. In escape.js, escapeHtml() escapes only < and >; make it turn & < > " ' into & < > " ' (& first, no double work). In render.js, change render(template, data) to render(template, data, { allowRaw = [] } = {}) and: escape {{key}}; insert {{{key}}} raw only when key is in allowRaw, else escape it like {{key}}; render undefined and null as "", other values with String() so 0 is "0"; handle {{{ }}} and {{ }} in one regex pass so an inserted value is never scanned again for {{name}}. Do not change src/pages or src/markdown.js. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
